primary.title: Bajaj Auto's ₹5,632 crore buyback: How will your buyback proceeds be taxed?
primary.summary: Bajaj Auto's ₹5,632.8-crore share buyback will be taxed under the new capital gains framework that came into effect on April 1, 2026, changing how shareholders report and pay tax on shares accepted in the buyback.
